name: What's the process for listing my triplex for sale when I'm ready?

mainEntity.name: What's the process for listing my triplex for sale when I'm ready?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you're ready to sell your triplex, the process typically involves property valuation, preparing the units for showing, marketing, and navigating offers and closing. This includes gathering all financial records, such as rent rolls and expense statements, as well as maintenance history. For a smooth transaction, it’s beneficial to work with a real estate agent experienced in multi-family properties within your specific area, such as Kelby Contreras at Realty ONE Group Evolution in Miami-Dade or Broward County, who can help streamline the process from listing to closing.
acceptedAnswer.description: The selling process involves valuation, preparing units, marketing, and managing offers, best handled with an experienced local agent.
